# 楞伽經宗通

**ID:** X0330
**Volume:** X17
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋經部／方等部疏
**Byline:** 明 曾鳳儀宗通
**Dynasty:** 明
**Date:** 1368–1644
**Juans:** 8
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0330

## Contributors
- 曾鳳儀 (A001305)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

X330 in eight fascicles is [曾鳳儀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9B%BE%E9%B3%B3%E5%84%80)'s late-Wàn-lì lay-Buddhist commentary on *[Léngqiéābáduōluó bǎo jīng 楞伽阿跋多羅寶經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0327)* (T670). The genre-name *zōngtōng* 宗通 ("penetrating the school's teaching") is distinctive to [曾鳳儀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9B%BE%E9%B3%B3%E5%84%80)'s coordinated late-life Buddhist project: he produced four such commentaries (on the *Śūraṅgama*, the *Lotus*, the *Laṅkāvatāra*, and the *Yuánjué*), all in the same generic register — programmatic doctrinal commentary delivered through a layman's voice.

**Abstract**

Note on naming: the catalog meta gives the author as "曾鳳儀宗" — a misreading. 宗通 is the title-genre, not part of the personal name. The author is [曾鳳儀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9B%BE%E9%B3%B3%E5%84%80) alone (DILA Authority A001305).

Date bracket follows the documented *zōngtōng*-project origin in 1597 and a probable completion in the 1610s, within [曾鳳儀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9B%BE%E9%B3%B3%E5%84%80)'s post-retirement productive period (after his Wànlì 11 / 1583 *jǐnshì* and resignation in protest over the heir-apparent dispute). The work is one of the principal late-Míng *lay-Buddhist* commentaries on the *Laṅkāvatāra*, and stands alongside the monastic productions of [德清](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%B7%E6%B8%85) ([KR6i0343](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0343)), [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) ([KR6i0345](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0345), [KR6i0346](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0346)), and [通潤](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%80%9A%E6%BD%A4) ([KR6i0348](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0348)) as part of the late-Míng commentarial canon.

Related canonical texts: parent sūtra [KR6i0327](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0327) (楞伽阿跋多羅寶經 / T670); [曾鳳儀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9B%BE%E9%B3%B3%E5%84%80)'s parallel *Léngyán zōngtōng* (X318) on the *Śūraṅgama*; *Diamond-sūtra* commentaries [KR6c0059](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0059) / [KR6c0060](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0060).
